'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Philippines|Philippine]] authorities confirm that all four people aboard a [[Cessna 340]] aircraft that crashed on February 18 on [[Mayon Volcano]], [[Albay]], are dead. Retrieval operations have begun. [https://www.philstar.com/headlines/2023/02/23/2247078/passengers-crashed-cessna-plane-mayon-confirmed-dead/ (''The Philippine Star'')] [https://www.cnn.com/2023/02/23/asia/philippines-plane-crash-volcano-deaths-intl-hnk/index.html (CNN)]
*A [[Russian Air Force]] [[Sukhoi Su-25|Su-25]] jet crashes in [[Orekhovo, Belgorod Oblast|Orekhovo]], [[Belgorod Oblast]], [[Russia]], while returning to its base, killing the pilot. [https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2023/02/23/russian-air-force-pilot-killed-in-plane-crash-near-ukraine-border-a80317 (''The Moscow Times'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[Colombia–Nicaragua relations]], [[Human rights in Nicaragua]]
**The [[Colombian government]] "condemns the arbitrary actions carried out by the [[Daniel Ortega|Ortega]] regime against its opposition" and offers [[Colombian nationality law|Colombian citizenship]] to those facing political persecution. [http://cancilleria.gov.co/newsroom/publiques/comunicado-prensa-60 (Cancillería de Colombia)]
*[[Nuclear program of Iran]]
**[[Iran]] publicly acknowledges accusations by the [[International Atomic Energy Agency]] that it has [[enriched uranium]] to 84%, bringing it close to developing a [[nuclear weapon]]. However, the [[Government of Iran|government]] maintains that its nuclear program is "completely peaceful". [https://apnews.com/article/iran-politics-international-atomic-energy-agency-israel-government-benjamin-netanyahu-45b623742bb6bd4c7314de7df6c3f1e9m (AP)]
*[[Israel–Oman relations]]
**[[Oman]] opens its [[airspace]] to [[Israel]]i [[List of airlines of Israel|airline]]s for the first time. [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Israel)|Israeli Foreign Minister]] [[Eli Cohen (politician born 1972)|Eli Cohen]] calls the decision historic. [https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/2023-02-23/ty-article/.premium/oman-allows-israeli-flights-into-airspace-fm-praises-historic-decision/00000186-7dd7-da01-abaf-7ff7b40b0000 (Haaretz)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Protests against the Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Protests against the Russo-Ukrainian war]]
**Pro-[[Ukraine]] protesters confront visitors heading to the [[Embassy of Russia, Washington, D.C.|Russian embassy]] in [[Washington, D.C.]], [[United States]]. [https://thehill.com/policy/international/3872763-ukraine-protesters-confront-those-attending-party-at-russian-embassy/ (''The Hill'')]
*[[2023 Wamena riot]]
**At least nine people are killed and 14 others are injured following a [[riot]] in [[Wamena]], [[Highland Papua]], [[Indonesia]], after rumours circulated on [[social media]] that a [[child abduction|child had been kidnapped]]. The [[Indonesian National Armed Forces|Indonesian military]] has been deployed to the town to support local police. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/2/24/indonesia-boosts-security-in-papua-after-9-killed-in-riot (Al Jazeera)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[State Minister of Artsakh|State Minister]] [[Ruben Vardanyan (politician)|Ruben Vardanyan]] of the unrecognized [[Republic of Artsakh]] is [[dismissal (employment)|dismissed]] by [[President of Artsakh|President]] [[Arayik Harutyunyan]] after less than four months in office. [https://meduza.io/en/news/2023/02/23/ruben-vardanyan-steps-down-from-artsakh-prime-minister-post-after-less-than-4-months-in-office (''Meduza'')]
